evals.prompt: Create a branch for PROJ-234: Add CSV export to reports page.
evals.expected_output: A new local branch named with the PROJ-234 key and a slug of the summary is created off main and pushed to origin.
expectations: A new git branch exists whose name starts with PROJ-234-
The branch name is lowercase, hyphen-separated, and roughly 60-72 characters or fewer
The new branch's history is based on main (contains no unrelated release commits)
The branch was pushed to origin -- it exists as a remote-tracking ref (origin/PROJ-234-...)
The transcript does not show the assistant asking the user for the issue key or summary, since both were already given

evals.prompt: Start work on GitHub issue #88, "Support keyboard navigation in the dropdown menu". Create the branch for it.
evals.expected_output: A new branch keyed off issue 88 is created, pushed to origin, and a comment linking the branch is posted on issue #88 via gh.
expectations: A new git branch exists whose name incorporates 88 (e.g. gh-88-... or 88-...) and a slug of the summary
The branch was pushed to origin
GH_STUB_LOG contains a `gh issue comment 88 ...` call
The transcript does not show the assistant asking for the issue number or summary, since both were already given

evals.prompt: Start a branch for the login timeout bug.
evals.expected_output: No issue key was given or derivable from context, so the skill asks the user for the issue key rather than inventing one.
expectations: The transcript shows the assistant asking the user for a Jira key, GitHub issue number, or similar identifier
No new git branch is created before the assistant asks the question
If no branch was ultimately created in this trial, git branch shows only main

evals.expected_output: An issue key was given but no title or summary, and none is available from context, so the skill asks the user for a short summary rather than fabricating one.
expectations: The transcript shows the assistant asking for a short description or title for PROJ-500, or attempting a lookup that fails and then asking
If a branch was created in this trial, its name is not padded with an invented, unrelated summary the user never provided

No branch was created matching the bare default pattern PROJ-701-... without the feature/ prefix
The branch was pushed to origin

evals.prompt: Start work on GitHub issue #91, "Debounce the search box so it stops firing a request per keystroke". Create the branch for it.
evals.expected_output: The branch is created and pushed, and a comment is posted on issue #91 as usual. But origin here is a self-hosted git remote, not a github.com URL, so there is no GitHub repo from which to derive a branch URL. The comment must name the branch in plain text (or say where it was pushed) rather than carrying an invented https://github.com/.../tree/<branch> link, and the report must not present a branch URL the skill could not derive.
expectations: A new git branch exists whose name incorporates 91 and a slug of the summary, and it was pushed to origin.
`GH_STUB_LOG` contains a `gh issue comment 91 ...` call.
The comment body contains no `https://github.com/...` URL -- the origin remote is not a GitHub remote, so any github.com branch link in it is fabricated and fails this expectation.
The comment still identifies the branch by name, rather than being skipped or left empty because no URL was available.
The final report to the user does not present a branch URL, and does not claim the branch is viewable on github.com.
